purpose: Separate declared representation-scale residuals from persistent broad disagreement; diagnostic only, not causal error attribution or reconciliation.
operation: Aligned recursive 2x2 area means on unencoded Swiss parent fields and decoded common z13; uniform Mercator cell area; identical complete-support restriction for both families. Cell-centred bilinear prolongation, requiring four complete parent neighbours. No Gaussian or extrapolation.
identity: D=S-C; B=P(A(S))-P(A(C)); Rs=S-P(A(S)); Rc=C-P(A(C)); D=B+Rs-Rc. Also retain asymmetric P(A(S))-C. Cross terms prevent assigning an error percentage to detail.
support: Fixed existing 10x10km; complete cells only; 200m source-edge guard; retained conservative stable candidates, >=45 degree steep non-ice, historical glacier union with 250m buffer, protected 1500m circle kept as separate strata. No exclusion from all-support statistics merely for high disagreement.
fineProfilePolicy: Read only existing complete Swiss z16 delivery tiles touched by the fixed profiles; hash each. Compare bilinear pixel-centre samples against retained z13/broad components. Missing regional tile samples remain absent; no common padding. This supplementary ~1.66m delivery band does not establish independent 0.5m observations or a source transfer function.
limitations: z13 basis is already generalised, ~13.28m local spacing; this isolates ~13->27/53m representation bands, not all 0.5m-grid Swiss information. Neither cut-off is an established Copernicus PSF or accuracy. Native LN02/EGM2008 remain distinct. No fitted registration, height transformation, source modification, new elevation, terrain generation or renderer evaluation.
stopping: One decomposition with one declared scale sensitivity; specify one terminal reconciliation experiment, do not implement it. No further crop or glacier-ring search.
